tips.text: Do not stab your Lich until one Requiem is revealed; a blind stab only ranks it up.
Clear the whole map and wait for Thralls instead of rushing to extraction; they spawn on a timer.
Players call the Kuva Lich the slowest of the three adversary systems, and the Technocyte Coda the one they prefer.
Put Oull in slot 1 and your first revealed Requiem in slot 2; you finish in four stabs without the third reveal.
Buy the Requiem Ultimatum from Palladino every week and use it solo to skip the wait for the Lich to spawn.
Run long missions like Survival or Interception first for Murmurs, then short Captures to make the Lich appear.
Let your Lich convert nearby enemies into Thralls before you down it, for extra Murmurs.
Run Lich nodes in public squads; a squadmate failed stab gives you Murmurs too.
Roll Larvlings solo so a squadmate cannot take the Mercy or mix in their progenitor.
Bring a wide area nuke frame such as Saryn, Mag, Volt or Rhino for the kill count; it needs no line of sight.
Stock one or two of every Requiem mod before you Mercy a Larvling; a Kuva Flood or two covers it.
Run the Saturn Proxima confrontation solo; a squad adds no reward.
Add shield and hull mods to your Railjack before the showdown; a weak ship makes it a gamble.
Keep every copy and fuse them all into the highest roll; fusing as you go wastes progress.
Write down each copy bonus before you Vanquish; the Foundry does not show it.
Expect one to two hours per Lich with Oull and an Ultimatum, and three or four hours for a first one.
Bring an invisibility frame such as Ivara so the Lich can convert Thralls without killing you.
Do not agonize over the progenitor; Elemental Vice swaps the element later.
Stop at a copy showing 53%; its next fusion reaches 60%.
Players split on the Brakk; one copy at any bonus is all Mastery needs.
Switch to a Grineer Exterminate such as Telesto if Cassini stops giving Larvlings.
